body:
## Pull request overview This PR implements SSH policy security fixes to align with Tailscale's security model, addressing issues #3009 and #3010. The changes introduce strict validation rules for SSH source/destination combinations and remove support for wildcard destinations. **Changes:** - Removes wildcard (`*`) as an SSH destination - users must now use `autogroup:member`, `autogroup:tagged`, or specific tags/users - Adds validation preventing tags/autogroup:tagged from SSHing to user-owned devices - Adds validation requiring username destinations to have the same single user as source - Adds comprehensive test coverage for all validation rules ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | hscontrol/policy/v2/types.go | Adds SSH validation errors, `validateSSHSrcDstCombination()` function, and updates UnmarshalJSON/MarshalJSON to reject wildcard in SSH destinations | | hscontrol/policy/v2/types_test.go | Updates existing tests to use valid SSH patterns and adds comprehensive validation test cases covering all security rules | | hscontrol/policy/v2/filter_test.go | Updates SSH user mapping tests to use tagged destinations instead of username destinations | | hscontrol/policy/policy_test.go | Updates SSH policy tests to use valid patterns (groups to tags instead of groups to users) | | integration/ssh_test.go | Updates integration tests to use autogroup:member/tagged instead of wildcard, corrects TestSSHMultipleUsersAllToAll behavior, adds TestSSHPolicyValidationErrors for validation testing | | CHANGELOG.md | Documents breaking changes with clear examples of invalid and valid patterns | | .github/workflows/test-integration.yaml | Adds TestSSHPolicyValidationErrors to the integration test workflow |
